id: 01_Electrical Safety in hindi Electrical injuries Shock Severity Hazards & Protecti
title: 认识电：触电伤害与基本防护
source_doc: course/Electrical Safety Series/01_Electrical Safety in hindi Electrical injuries Shock Severity Hazards & Protecti.md
author_source: project/Electrical Safety Series/01_Electrical Safety in hindi Electrical injuries Shock Severity Hazards & Protecti/src.py

points.K13: 经过心脏的路径最危险
points.K16: 危害：布线、裸露、绝缘破损
points.K18: 危害：坏工具、错防护、架空线

shots.scene: 欣欣站在白板前，白板旁画着闪电和灯泡，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a blank whiteboard decorated with a lightning bolt and a glowing light bulb drawing, waving at the camera.
shots.narration: 今天我们来聊聊电。
overlay: 认识电：触电伤害与基本防护

shots.scene: 灯泡、警示三角、盾牌三个图标排成一行
shots.prompt_en: Three icons in a row: a light bulb, a yellow warning triangle and a shield. No people.
shots.narration: 电是什么、有什么危害、怎么防。

shots.scene: 阿杰站在工作间配电柜前，好奇地看着柜门
shots.prompt_en: The young male student stands in a workshop in front of a large electrical cabinet, looking curiously at its door.
shots.narration: 阿杰第一次来到配电柜前。

shots.scene: 老李戴安全帽，用仪表在配电柜旁测量
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer wearing a hard hat measures with a handheld meter beside the electrical cabinet.
shots.narration: 老李正在用仪表做测量。

shots.scene: 阿杰挠头，头顶冒出问号
shots.prompt_en: The young male student scratches his head with a question mark bubble above him.
shots.narration: 阿杰问：电到底有多危险？

shots.scene: 欣欣在空白白板前竖起手指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a blank whiteboard and raises one finger.
shots.narration: 我们从头讲起。

shots.scene: 欣欣严肃地站在当心触电标志前
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands with a serious face in front of a large electric shock warning sign.
shots.narration: 电是很大的危害，关系到人命。

shots.scene: 灯泡、齿轮、警示三角三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a light bulb, a gear and a yellow warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 弄懂原理和危害，才能阻止事故。

shots.scene: 发电厂图标经过电线连到一盏灯
shots.prompt_en: A power station icon connected by a long wire to a lamp that lights up. No people.
shots.narration: 电是能量从一处流到另一处。

shots.scene: 发电厂图标放大
shots.prompt_en: A large power station icon with cooling towers and transmission towers. No people.
shots.narration: 它需要电源，比如发电站。

shots.scene: 小圆点沿导线流动的示意
shots.prompt_en: Small glowing dots moving along a copper wire, shown in a simple cutaway view. No people.
shots.narration: 电子沿着导体流动，这就是电流。

shots.scene: 闭合环路亮灯打勾
shots.prompt_en: A simple closed circuit loop with a lit bulb and a green check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 而且只在闭合回路里流动。

shots.scene: 导线中电荷流动的示意
shots.prompt_en: A wire with glowing dots flowing steadily in one direction, with arrows. No people.
shots.narration: 电流，就是电荷的移动。

shots.scene: 空白表盘的电流表图标
shots.prompt_en: An ammeter icon with a blank dial and a moving needle. No people.
shots.narration: 它用安培来度量。

shots.scene: 电池、导线、灯泡连成一圈
shots.prompt_en: A battery, wires and a light bulb connected in a complete loop, the bulb glowing. No people.
shots.narration: 电路，是电流走的完整路径。

shots.scene: 电源、导线、负载三个图标，负载为台灯、工具、加热器
shots.prompt_en: Three icons connected in a line: a power source, a wire and a load group showing a lamp, a power tool and a heater. No people.
shots.narration: 由电源、导体和负载组成。

shots.scene: 导线中有一段变窄，小圆点在那里变慢
shots.prompt_en: A wire with a narrow section where the glowing dots slow down and bunch up. No people.
shots.narration: 电阻，是对电流的限制。

shots.scene: 铜线、铝条、铁钉图标，电流顺畅通过
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a copper wire, an aluminum bar and an iron nail with glowing dots flowing easily through them. No people.
shots.narration: 金属这类物质，电阻很小，

shots.scene: 欣欣指着一根铜线，旁边是闪电图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points at a copper wire next to a small lightning bolt icon.
shots.narration: 电很容易通过，叫作导体。

shots.scene: 设备金属外壳经绿黄色导线连到地下接地极
shots.prompt_en: A metal equipment cabinet connected by a green and yellow wire down to a grounding rod in the earth, cutaway view. No people.
shots.narration: 接地，是把导电部分连到大地。

shots.scene: 盾牌图标打勾，旁边接地符号
shots.prompt_en: A large shield icon with a green check mark and a small ground symbol. No people.
shots.narration: 它是一种防止触电的保护措施。

shots.scene: 玻璃杯、陶瓷瓶、塑料管、干木块图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a glass, a porcelain insulator, a plastic tube and a dry wooden block in a row. No people.
shots.narration: 玻璃、陶瓷、塑料、干木头，

shots.scene: 电线外包塑料皮，电流被挡在里面
shots.prompt_en: A cutaway of an electric cable showing glowing dots kept inside by the plastic insulation layer. No people.
shots.narration: 电阻很高，不让电跑到别处去。

shots.scene: 欣欣举着两张空白卡片
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up two blank cards, one in each hand.
shots.narration: 电气伤害主要有两类。

shots.scene: 电击、烧伤、死亡三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a person pictogram struck by a lightning bolt, a hand with a burn mark and a gravestone outline. No people.
shots.narration: 直接伤害：电击致死、电击、烧伤。

shots.scene: 梯子上的人形图标触电后跌落
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a person pictogram on a ladder touching a wire with a small spark, then falling, with a red warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 间接伤害：触电后从高处坠落。

shots.scene: 坠落的人形图标旁有警示三角
shots.prompt_en: A fallen person pictogram on the ground beside a tall ladder with a red warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 电本身没伤到，摔下来却可能致命。

shots.scene: 人体轮廓中有电流箭头穿过
shots.prompt_en: A simple human body outline with a glowing current arrow passing through it. No people.
shots.narration: 电流通过人体，人就受到电击。

shots.scene: 欣欣身边浮现三张空白卡片
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside three blank cards floating in the air.
shots.narration: 电击多严重，取决于三点。

shots.scene: 人体轮廓：电流从手进入，经躯干从脚流到接地金属
shots.prompt_en: A human body outline: current enters at one hand from a live wire, passes through the torso and exits at the foot into a grounded metal plate. No people.
shots.narration: 一是电流在体内走的路径。

shots.scene: 仪表指针从低到高
shots.prompt_en: A gauge icon with a needle rising from low to high, next to a body outline. No people.
shots.narration: 二是流过身体的电流有多大。

shots.scene: 三个逐渐变大的电流箭头
shots.prompt_en: Three current arrows of increasing size next to a body outline. No people.
shots.narration: 比如30、40、100安培，越大越重。

shots.scene: 沙漏图标
shots.prompt_en: An hourglass icon next to a body outline with a current arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 三是电流持续通过的时间。

shots.scene: 小插座图标旁有警示三角
shots.prompt_en: A small wall socket icon with a yellow warning triangle beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 注意：低电压不等于低危险。

shots.section_title: 经过心脏的路径最危险
shots.scene: 人体轮廓，心脏处发红
shots.prompt_en: A human body outline with the heart highlighted in red. No people.
shots.narration: 最要命的路径，是经过心脏。
overlay: 经过心脏的路径最危险

shots.section_title: 经过心脏的路径最危险
shots.scene: 电流从一只手到另一只手穿过胸口
shots.prompt_en: A body outline with a current line from one hand across the chest to the other hand, crossing the heart. No people.
shots.narration: 第一种，手到手。

shots.section_title: 经过心脏的路径最危险
shots.scene: 电流从手到脚穿过心脏
shots.prompt_en: A body outline with a current line from one hand down through the chest to the opposite foot. No people.
shots.narration: 第二种，手到脚。

shots.section_title: 经过心脏的路径最危险
shots.scene: 电流从头到脚穿过心脏
shots.prompt_en: A body outline with a current line from the head straight down through the chest to the feet. No people.
shots.narration: 第三种，头到脚。

shots.section_title: 经过心脏的路径最危险
shots.scene: 电流从一只脚到另一只脚，心脏未高亮
shots.prompt_en: A body outline with a current line from one foot to the other, the heart not highlighted, small caution sign. No people.
shots.narration: 脚到脚等不经心脏的，相对较轻。

shots.scene: 手握导线的图标，手臂肌肉发紧
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a hand gripping a wire, arm muscles drawn tense with zigzag lines. No people.
shots.narration: 电流超过10毫安，肌肉会麻痹。

shots.scene: 握住的手上方有锁的图标
shots.prompt_en: A clenched hand icon with a small lock symbol above it. No people.
shots.narration: 肌肉被冻住，人松不开手。

shots.scene: 心电图线变得杂乱
shots.prompt_en: A heartbeat line icon that turns from regular waves into rapid chaotic zigzags. No people.
shots.narration: 超过75毫安，心脏快速无效跳动。

shots.scene: 时钟图标和警示三角
shots.prompt_en: A clock icon with a red warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 不用除颤器，几分钟内就会死亡。

shots.scene: 墙上的AED急救箱和打开的除颤器
shots.prompt_en: An automated external defibrillator cabinet on a wall and an open defibrillator case beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 心跳或呼吸停止时，就要用AED。

shots.section_title: 危害：布线、裸露、绝缘破损
shots.scene: 欣欣站在白板左栏前，右栏空着
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a whiteboard divided into two empty columns, pointing at the left column.
shots.narration: 先看危害，再看防护。
overlay: 危害：布线、裸露、绝缘破损

shots.section_title: 危害：布线、裸露、绝缘破损
shots.scene: 墙上乱拉的电线图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of messy tangled wires hanging along a wall, with a red warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 布线不当。

shots.section_title: 危害：布线、裸露、绝缘破损
shots.scene: 开关盒盖子掉了、露出铜线
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a switch box with its cover missing and bare copper wires exposed, with a red warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 电气部件裸露在外。

shots.section_title: 危害：布线、裸露、绝缘破损
shots.scene: 电线外皮开裂露出铜芯
shots.prompt_en: A close icon of a power cord with cracked insulation showing the copper core, with a red warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 导线绝缘不良。

shots.scene: 电动工具插头缺了接地脚
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a power tool plug with its ground pin missing, with a red warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 电气系统和工具没有接地。

shots.scene: 一条线路标着100A，却接了一大堆负载冒热气
shots.prompt_en: An icon of one circuit line feeding a large pile of machines, the wire glowing hot with heat waves. No people.
shots.narration: 线路能带100安，却接更大负载。

shots.scene: 过热导线的特写
shots.prompt_en: A close icon of an overheated wire glowing red. No people.
shots.narration: 这就是电路过载。

shots.section_title: 危害：坏工具、错防护、架空线
shots.scene: 外壳开裂的电钻图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of an electric drill with a cracked housing and a red warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 使用损坏的电动工具和设备。
overlay: 危害：坏工具、错防护、架空线

shots.section_title: 危害：坏工具、错防护、架空线
shots.scene: 不合适的手套和金属螺丝刀图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of thin cloth gloves and an uninsulated metal screwdriver with a red warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 用错了个人防护用品和工具。

shots.section_title: 危害：坏工具、错防护、架空线
shots.scene: 高处的架空电线和一架金属梯子靠近
shots.prompt_en: An icon of overhead power lines on poles with a long metal ladder tilting close to them, red warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 还有头顶的架空电力线。

shots.scene: 地面积水中放着插线板
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a power strip lying in a puddle of water on the floor, with a red warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 潮湿时，所有危害都更严重。

shots.scene: 电击、火焰、爆炸、电弧四个图标
shots.prompt_en: Four icons in a row: an electric shock symbol, a flame, an explosion burst and a bright arc spark. No people.
shots.narration: 后果有电击、火灾、爆炸和电弧。

shots.scene: 欣欣指向白板右栏
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points at the right column of a two-column whiteboard.
shots.narration: 防护措施第一条：正确接地。

shots.scene: 设备外壳连接接地线，打绿勾
shots.prompt_en: A machine with its metal housing connected to a green and yellow ground wire, green check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 设备外壳要可靠接地。

shots.scene: 带测试按钮的漏电保护器
shots.prompt_en: A residual current circuit breaker with a small test button inside an open distribution box. No people.
shots.narration: 使用GFCI或ELCB漏电保护。

shots.scene: 漏电保护器跳闸，人形图标旁有盾牌
shots.prompt_en: The breaker lever flips down to off, and a person pictogram next to it is protected by a shield. No people.
shots.narration: 发生接地故障时，它会切断电源。

shots.scene: 熔断器和断路器图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a cartridge fuse and a miniature circuit breaker side by side. No people.
shots.narration: 使用合适的熔断器和断路器。

shots.scene: 接线端子被透明护罩罩住
shots.prompt_en: Electrical terminals covered by a clear protective cover with a green check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 带电部件要遮护起来。

shots.scene: 老李在断开的开关上挂锁和空白标签
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer attaches a padlock and a blank tag to a switched-off isolating switch.
shots.narration: 在线路上作业前，先上锁挂牌。

shots.scene: 完好的电源线和延长线整齐摆放
shots.prompt_en: An intact power cord and an extension cord neatly coiled and laid out, green check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 软线、延长线要正确使用。

shots.scene: 老李把配电柜门关好
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer closes the door of a large electrical panel with an electric shock warning sign on it.
shots.narration: 配电盘和电气面板要关好。

shots.scene: 关闭的配电柜前有禁止靠近图标
shots.prompt_en: A closed electrical panel with a no entry for unauthorized persons icon in front of it. No people.
shots.narration: 让无关的人碰不到带电部分。

shots.scene: 雨天和积水图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: Icons of rain clouds and a wet floor puddle beside a power tool, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 避免在潮湿条件下作业。

shots.scene: 王老师给一组学员讲课
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator teaches a small group of trainees in a training room in front of a blank screen with an electric shock warning sign.
shots.narration: 最后一条：培训。

shots.scene: 老李和阿杰一起听讲
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer and the young male student sit together taking notes in the training room.
shots.narration: 接触带电线路的人，必须先培训。

shots.scene: 灯泡、警示三角、盾牌、手接触电线四个图标
shots.prompt_en: Four icons: a light bulb, a warning triangle, a shield and a hand near a live wire with a question mark. No people.
shots.narration: 懂电、懂危害、懂防护和应对。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现闭合电路、接地、绝缘三个图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside floating icons of a closed circuit, a ground symbol and an insulated cable.
shots.narration: 电走闭合回路，接地和绝缘保护人。

shots.scene: 人体轮廓心脏高亮，旁边沙漏和仪表
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a body outline with the heart highlighted, an hourglass and a gauge. No people.
shots.narration: 路径、电流、时间，决定轻重。

shots.scene: 破线、裸露、过载、积水四个警示图标
shots.prompt_en: Four icons each with a red warning triangle: a cracked cord, exposed wires, an overloaded circuit and a puddle. No people.
shots.narration: 布线、裸露、过载、潮湿，都是危害。

shots.scene: 接地、漏电保护器、护罩、挂锁、培训五个打勾图标
shots.prompt_en: Five icons with green checks: a ground symbol, a residual current breaker, a protective cover, a padlock and a classroom. No people.
shots.narration: 接地、漏保、遮护、上锁、培训。

shots.scene: 欣欣在白板前挥手道别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye at the camera in front of a whiteboard with a lightning bolt drawing.
shots.narration: 懂电才能防电，下次见！
